opennyai_summary.23_March_2023__facts:
The case of the pps 1 of 3 7 aba 855-23.doc prosecution is that one vehicle bearing No. MH 45 AM 3771 was intercepted, and upon taking search of the said vehicle, it was revealed that the said vehicle was used to transport Gutkha pan masala from Karnataka to Mahrashtra.
It is alleged that the driver of the said vehicle had disclosed that the Applicant is the owner of the gutkha which was being transported by the said vehicle.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: It may be mentioned that apart from the statement of the co- accused, there is no other material to show the involvement of the Applicant.
opennyai_summary.23_March_2023__decision:
Moreover, the issue of applicability of Section 328 in such cases is pending before the Honourable the Supreme Court.
The other offences under Indian Penal Code are punishable with maximum punishment of 6 months.
It is stated that the matter is scheduled to be listed before the Honourable Supreme Court on 13.04.2023.
Hence, stand over to 17.04.2023.
5.
The Applicant is granted interim bail till the next date of hearing on the following terms and conditions:-
(i) In the event of arrest of the Applicant in Crime No. C.R.No.155 of 2023 registered with Mangalvedha Police Station, Solapur, the Applicant be released on interim bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twentyfive Thousand Only) with one or two pps 2 of 3 7 aba 855-23.doc sureties in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigation Officer.
(ii) The Applicant shall report to the Investigating Officer for two days on 27th and 28th March,
2023 from 11.00 a.m. till 2.00 p.m. further as and when required by the Investigating Officer for the purpose of investigation and interrogation.
(iii) The Applicant shall keep the Investigating Officer informed of his current address and mobile/contact details, and/or change of residence or mobile/contact details from time to time.
(iv) The Applicant shall not interfere with the Complainant and the other witnesses, or tamper with the evidence in any manner.

This is a  pre-arrest bail in connection with FIR No.155 of 2023 reg  Mangalveda Police Station, Solapur for the offenses under  188, 272, 273, 328 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC', for Section 26(2)(i), (ii), (iv), 27(3)(e), 30(2)(a), 59 of F  Standards Act, 2006.
No grievance is made about the Applicant's  co-operation with investigation.

2. By an order dated 23.03.2023, the interim protec  granted to the Applicant on certain terms and conditions.
4. Considering the fact that charge sheet is already filed, and that  the issue regarding applicability of Section 328 of IPC to Gutakha is  pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court and further considering  that the Applicant is already protected for last 2 years, case for grant  of pre-arrest bail is made.
Hence, following order.
ORDER (i) The Application is allowed in terms of the interim order dated 23.03.2023.
(ii) The Applicant is directed to remain present and attend the trial as and when directed by the Trial Court.
5. Application is disposed of in above terms.
